readings.repeat: intron 9 (legacy IVS8) TG and poly-T tract
readings.reading: 5T: 1 copy with the 5T poly-T tract, TG11 or TG12 on the 5T copy, not told by the counts (TG11-5T/TG12-7T or TG12-5T/TG11-7T). 5T lowers the splicing of exon 10 and is a variable-penetrance allele: with TG12 or TG13 on the same copy it more often causes CBAVD or another CFTR-related disorder when the other copy carries a CF-causing variant. One R117H copy and one 5T copy: phase unknown. R117H lies 17.6 kb from the tract, farther than a read pair spans, so whether they share a copy (in cis, a CF-causing allele of variable penetrance) or not (in trans) is not read; testing a parent tells them apart.

*1/*28 (TA6/TA7, 7/8 TA units as ExpansionHunter counts them): 1 decreased-function allele (*28 and *37 are decreased function). PharmCAT (step 7) called *1/*28: the same number of *28 and *37 copies.

not tested by any step. CPIC's 2023 SSRI guideline (Bousman et al. 2023, PMID 37032427) found that the data on SLC6A4 do not support its use in antidepressant prescribing, so a result would carry no recommendation.
